title: Pick a venue for the coding showcase

public.summary: Choose a venue for a 60-guest youth coding showcase using the requirements and the venue table.
public.statement: The fictional Maple Harbor Youth Coding Club is hosting an end-of-term showcase for 60 guests: students, families, and mentors. You are helping the organisers choose one venue from the table below. Choose a venue that meets every listed requirement. If more than one venue qualifies, any qualifying venue is accepted; say why you chose yours.
facts: The club's budget for the venue is $500.
Two of the confirmed guests use wheelchairs.
Most families will arrive by bus or light rail.

fact_table.caption: Venue options (fictional)
rows: No — three front steps, no ramp

constraints.text: Venue cost must be $500 or less.
Capacity must be at least 60 people.
The venue must have a step-free entrance so every guest can get in.
The venue must be at most a 12-minute walk from transit.

public.explanation_prompt: Which requirements ruled venues out? What trade-offs did you weigh between the remaining options?

provenance.author: Reasoning Lab project team
provenance.contamination_note: Original fictional data; not published before 2026-10-16.

preferences: A lower cost or shorter walk may be preferable, but any venue meeting every requirement is accepted.

anchors.constraints: Credit requires naming the requirement (e.g. wheelchair access), not just the venue.

review.notes: Matched variants differ only in the STEP-FREE requirement and the wheelchair-user fact.

reviewed_explanation.text: Westfield is over budget, Oak Street is too small, and Pine Grove is a 25-minute walk from transit. Of the rest, Riverside Hall has front steps with no ramp and Summit Arts Loft is on a second floor with no lift, so neither meets the step-free requirement. Harbor Community Center is the only venue that meets every requirement, though it is the furthest of the qualifying walks at 9 minutes.

reviewed_explanation.accepted_summary: Riverside Hall, Harbor Community Center, or Summit Arts Loft.
